summary: Bind synchronized metadata to the active ScreenCloud organization and require optimistic concurrency for Playgrounds data uploads.
reason: A credential change must not allow organization-scoped analysis to reuse a fresh mirror from another organization, and data writes must not overwrite changes made after the caller's last read.
validated_outcome: Focused safety tests, the full Go test suite, go vet, go build, and a fresh authenticated read-only dogfood matrix passed (148 evaluated checks, 0 failures); mutation-shaped cases remained dry-run only.
